subject: playwright.config.ts on shared (86f6278) now builds webServer from webServers(): add your APP_ENV=prod server to that array
body: With a DATABASE_URL, webServers() returns two servers: the Aegra host on E2E_PORT (migrate_all first) and a budget-zero host on E2E_PORT+1 (agent.spec.ts uses it). Without one, the single plain naadi_api.main:app server. Please append your prod-gate server as a third entry with its own port (E2E_PORT+2 is free) and reuse env() with APP_ENV overridden; env() also sets DEBUG=false because Aegra parses DEBUG as a boolean. Auth storage states are per origin now (authStatePath(role, baseURL)).
